company.shortDescription: Qashio is a financial technology company that provides corporate cards and business expense management software.
company.description: Qashio is a financial technology company that provides corporate expense management and spend control software for businesses. The platform combines corporate payment cards, expense tracking tools, approval workflows, invoice management, and accounts payable automation into a single system used by companies to manage operational spending.

productsAndServices.description: A corporate expense management platform for issuing cards, tracking transactions, applying spending controls, automating expense processes, and integrating finance data with accounting and ERP systems.
productsAndServices.name: Qashio Spend

productsAndServices.description: Physical and virtual prepaid Visa corporate cards that businesses can issue to employees, configure with spending limits and controls, and monitor through a centralized expense platform.
productsAndServices.name: Qashio Corporate Cards

productsAndServices.description: A business spending rewards program that awards points on eligible Qashio card transactions and allows companies to redeem them for travel miles, cashback, partner rewards, and other benefits.
productsAndServices.name: Qashio Points

productsAndServices.description: An accounts payable management service for organizing vendor payments, improving payment workflows, managing cash flow, and maintaining supplier relationships.
productsAndServices.name: Qashio Accounts

productsAndServices.description: A corporate travel management solution for coordinating business travel bookings, travel-related payments, and associated expense visibility in one platform.
productsAndServices.name: Qashio Corporate Travel

productsAndServices.description: A travel payments and expense solution for travel agencies, booking platforms, and other travel businesses that need controlled payment methods and transaction visibility.
productsAndServices.name: Qashio for Travel
